item.title: Kris Nelson to be Inducted into NWCA Jim Koch Division II Men’s Wrestling Hall of Fame
item.description: MANHEIM, Pa. – The National Wrestling Coaches’ Association (NWCA) announced that Minnesota State Moorhead head wrestling coach Kris Nelson will be inducted into the Jim Koch Division II Men’s Wrestling Hall of Fame. Nelson will be inducted on August 1, 2026, as a part of the 2026 NWCA Convention at the Renaissance Baltimore Harborplace Hotel ... Continue reading → Source

item.title: Millard Garners Big Ten Freshman of the Week Honors
item.description: MINNEAPOLIS — Minnesota’s Charlie Millard has been named the Big Ten Freshman of the Week for the second time in his career, the conference announced Thursday. A redshirt freshman, Millard helped No. 7 Minnesota to a 21-16 win at No. 4 Iowa on Friday. The win marked the Golden Gophers’ first win over the Hawkeyes ... Continue reading → Source

item.title: Final Road Trip Sends Gophers to Rutgers, Maryland
item.description: MINNEAPOLIS — No. 7/13 Minnesota (9-4, 3-2 B1G) closes out the road portion of its 2025-26 schedule with a pair of duals this weekend.
